                                                                                                                                                            Julia Hindle
                                                                                                                                                   1 year ago

                                                                                        The recipe I've always seen has zinc oxide, so that's
                                                                                            what I used here. Zinc is an important ingredient for
                                                                                                       developing micro or macro crystals.



                                                                                                                          Maison Stoï
                                                                                                                                                   1 year ago

                                                                                                                          Julia Hindle thanks! So you added Added 3% rutile +
                                                                   3% titanium + 1,75% CuCo in addition of the 6,5 rutile
                                                                                          and 2 copper carb?


                                                                                                         Just to be sure :)



                                                                                                                                                            Julia Hindle
                                                                                                                                                   1 year ago

                                                                                              Maison Stoï No problem! That image you see “3%
                                                                                                                                      rutile + 3% titanium + 1,75% CuCo” on actually isn’t
                                                                                                       mine, it’s from the user Lavinia Francesca Fantappiè. I
                                                                                              would guess she meant she used those amounts
                                                                                                            instead of the additions listed on my recipe rather than
                                                                                                                              in addition to.



                                                                                                                                                 Piotr Biczyk
                                                                                                                                          1 year ago

Is it important that copper is added as carbonate, as opposed
                                                                          to an oxide?



                                                                                    Naomi Duffey
                                                                                                            1 year ago

                                                                                       Piotr Biczyk from what I've heard, carbonate disperses
                                                                                        better. If you really blend your mixture oxide may be
                                                                                              fine, just reduce the oxide amount to match the lower
                                                                        percentage of the element in a carbonate - but you
                                                              knew that already, I'm sure.
                                                                                                                              ; )
